sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 17 (#16) and Internal Quality Checks row 17 (#16); no cell comments on either row
task/tests/**/* and task/solution/**/* (machine n-gram comparison against the agent-visible text only)
evidence: Source inspection of the frozen bytes; the agent image was not built or listed by me, so this is a source-level finding, not a runtime listing of /app. (1) task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (cmp). It copies only two things into the image, lines 14-15: 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; there is no COPY of solution/ or tests/. /app is created at lines 17-23 with only 'touch /app/.gitkeep' and a git init/commit of that one file. (2) The build context task/environment holds exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json (149 bytes) and six notes; no hidden files or symlinks. (3) seed_data.json is '"snippets": []' plus a one-sentence note ('No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history.'); it carries no source, schema or sample record. (4) The notes describe behaviour in prose and leave implementation open: policy.md:3 'You may choose the layout, labels, routes, database schema and error wording'; integration.md:5 'You may choose your routes and frontend tools'. The only route named is 'GET /api/health' (integration.md:3), which the template note also names. No starter, skeleton, schema, route list, partial UI or code block appears in any note; instruction.md:3 states 'there is no starter app to finish'. (5) Criterion/rubric reproduction: a word n-gram comparison of the 8 agent-visible files against every text file under tests/ and solution/ found no shared run of 9 or more words. At 6 words the only shared runs are generic phrases: 'draft that has a syntax error' and 'counted from the first line of' (behaviour.md vs scored/functional/judge.toml), 'the preview the console and the library' (ui.md vs scored/polish/judge.toml, 7 words), and 'the start and end of the' (ui.md vs the built solution bundle). (6) A grep of the agent-visible files for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|cw_ ids|GATE|probe|golden|oracle|solution|http returned no match. (7) solution/solve.sh installs by 'cp -a "$source_app/." "$target/"' from the solution folder only; nothing in the agent-visible text points at a public copy of the reference. task.toml 'provenance' and 'artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]' are not staged into the agent image. Counterexample attempts: a weak agent cannot assemble the deliverable from /instructions and /assets because neither holds code, markup, a schema or a route table; a conforming agent loses nothing from the absence of a starter because the brief says none exists. Not measured: a built-image listing of /app, /instructions and /assets, and whether a public copy of the source task this one was adapted from is reachable over the open network (task.toml:14 'Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task' names no location, and I did not search externally).
